premise: Pinecone thinks she's plain next to Flower's petals and Caterpillar's dots, nothing to give — until the sun opens her scales and a gust sends her little winged seeds spinning away over the meadow.
inspiration: Andersen's The Fir Tree, turned: the plain one doesn't wait for glory — her gift is already inside her, and it flies off to become a forest.
lesson: Everyone carries something wonderful, even when it doesn't show.
learning: Pine seeds have little wings and spin away on the wind.

en-US.title: Pinecone's Secret Seeds
en-US.text: In the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower opened her eight yellow petals, and {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar crawled up to admire them. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} So pretty! Beside them sat {pinecone:enter} Pinecone, brown and quiet. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] Flower has petals, she said. Caterpillar has green dots. I only have scales. {flower:wobble} Scales? said Flower. [softly] Wait for the sun. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Then out came the sun, warm and bright. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Pinecone felt her scales loosen… {pinecone:face happy} and {pinecone:live hold} {sfx:crackle} she opened them wide, like a flower. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] Oh! {canvas:wind 0.7 10s} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Then — whoosh! — a gust of wind. {pinecone:sparkle} Out from her scales flew tiny seeds, each with one little wing. Spin, spin, spin, away over the meadow! {caterpillar:live} Caterpillar reared up tall to watch them go. [curious] What were those? {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] Baby pine trees, said Flower. Every single one. {pinecone:glow} Pinecone didn't only have scales. She was full of trees.

es-ES.title: Las semillas secretas de Piña
es-ES.text: En el prado, {flower:enter} Flor abrió sus ocho pétalos amarillos, y {caterpillar:enter} Oruga se acercó reptando a admirarlos. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} ¡Qué bonitos! Al lado estaba {pinecone:enter} Piña, marrón y callada. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] Flor tiene pétalos, dijo. Oruga tiene lunares verdes. Yo solo tengo escamas. {flower:wobble} ¿Escamas? dijo Flor. [softly] Espera al sol. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Y salió el sol, calentito y brillante. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Piña notó que se le aflojaban las escamas… {pinecone:face happy} y {pinecone:live hold} {sfx:crackle} las abrió de par en par, como una flor. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Oh! {canvas:wind 0.7 10s} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Entonces… ¡fiuuu!, una ráfaga de viento. {pinecone:sparkle} De entre sus escamas salieron volando semillitas, cada una con un alita. ¡Vueltas y vueltas, por todo el prado! {caterpillar:live} Oruga se estiró bien alta para verlas marchar. [curious] ¿Qué eran? {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] Pinitos, dijo Flor. Todos y cada uno. {pinecone:glow} Piña no tenía solo escamas. Estaba llena de árboles.
